_comment: Argus per-device cadence contracts. Editable without code changes; reloaded per fleet read. type=service (Nyx-local, steady heartbeat) or battery (badge: check-in on wake + every N min awake, sleep windows count as healthy silence). silent_after_s = past this with no report => SILENT. sick_if floors => SICK. expected_firmware_hash set => drift flag when mismatch. sleep_windows are local-time HH:MM ranges (may wrap midnight).
